Flaky tests & how to kill them

Flaky tests fail without any code change. This post explains the three causes we found in a year of CI data, and what fixed each one.

First, shared state between tests. Second, timing assumptions such as fixed sleeps. Third, order dependence when the runner shuffles.

  • Isolate fixtures per test
  • Replace sleeps with explicit waits
  • Run with random order in CI

After the changes the flake rate went from 4.1% to 0.3% over six weeks — measured on 12 000 runs.
